text:
Estimated items before the meal:
- Toast: 3 slices of seeded or brown bread, about 40 g each, roughly 100 kcal each, so about 300 kcal in total. Only about 1 slice and a half was left, though that is unclear.
- Crumpet or pancake: about 60 g, roughly 110 kcal.
- Butter: 2 Meadowlea portions at 10 g each, about 70 kcal each, so about 140 kcal. Most of it was used, so I'll count about 120 kcal.
- Jam: 3 portions at 15 g each, about 40 kcal each, so about 120 kcal. Some was used, so I'll count about 80 kcal.
- Mandarin segments: about 80 g, roughly 40 kcal, all eaten.
- Orange juice: about 200 ml, roughly 85 kcal, and most of it was drunk (about 85%), so about 70 kcal.
- Tea with milk: about 20 kcal, with most left in the cup, so about 5 kcal.
- Sugar: 2 sticks left on the tray, uneaten.

Estimated items left after the meal: a piece of toast with butter and jam, and about half of a crumpet. That is roughly 1 slice of toast (a bit over half the original toast) and half the crumpet, which is about 100 + 55 = 155 kcal left uneaten, or about 70 g.

Toast and crumpet eaten: 300 + 110 − 155 = 255 kcal.

Total energy eaten: 255 + 120 (butter) + 80 (jam) + 40 (fruit) + 70 (juice) + 5 (tea) = 570 kcal.

Mass eaten: bread and crumpet (120 + 60 − 70 = 110 g), spreads (about 35 g), fruit (80 g), juice (170 g) and tea (20 g) come to about 415 g.
